ambient.title: Ambient Mode
ambient.description: Soft indirect illumination that creates a calm, relaxing atmosphere.

focus.description: Directed lighting for reading, working, and everyday productivity.

night.description: Warm, low-intensity light designed for evening environments.

halo.description: A subtle glowing ring that transforms the lamp into an atmospheric design object.

Features.mainHeading: Orbita integrates modern technology with intuitive controls

touch.title: 1. Touch Control
touch.description: Minimal touch sensor located on the base allows seamless switching between lighting modes.

smart.title: 2. Smart Connectivity
smart.description: Compatible with smart home systems via Bluetooth.

adaptive.title: 3. Adaptive Brightness
adaptive.description: Automatic brightness adjustment depending on ambient light conditions.

battery.title: 4. Battery Powered
battery.description: Portable use with long-lasting rechargeable battery.

Materials.label: (Materials)
Materials.heading: Orbita is constructed using carefully selected premium materials.

aluminum.title: Brushed Aluminum Body
aluminum.description: Precision-machined aluminum creates a refined industrial texture and durability.

diffuser.title: Optical Diffuser Disc
diffuser.description: Engineered to create smooth and uniform light distribution.

finish.title: Anodized Surface Finish
finish.description: Ensures resistance to scratches and fingerprints.

core.title: Precision Steel Core
core.description: Provides structural stability and perfect balance.

silver.title: Silver
silver.description: A brushed aluminum finish with a cool industrial character.

gold.title: Gold
gold.description: A warm anodized finish designed to complement natural interiors.

Sustainability.heading: Orbita was designed with environmental responsibility in mind.

led.title: Low Energy LED Technology
led.description: Consumes significantly less power than traditional lighting.

life.title: Long-Life Components
life.description: LED modules designed for over 50,000 hours of operation.

recyclable.title: Recyclable Materials
recyclable.description: The lamp body is made primarily from recyclable aluminum.
